item.content:encoded:
Uff! Reverse story-telling makes my brain hurt. Very good execution of a very difficult concept.

I'm curious why you made it a window into a parallel universe that's running backwards as opposed to a true temporal anomaly. I could see very interesting avenues where this crystal ball has been giving shamans/wizards visions of the future ne "spirit world" for centuries. Visions which the Foundation now has to scramble and snap up every trace of because they contain snippets of information from Foundation 2099 or whenever. Security risk and paradox risk at the same time. Plus, they need to figure out what was seen and when, so they can make sure that it is there to be seen at the proper future time, else you get the sort of nasty reality-destroying paradox that the organization is meant to prevent.

Edit: in massively delayed retrospect, I have no idea why I thought alternate universes.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: That (the former description) is apparently what's happening. It appears that SCP-873' is moving back in the Foundation's own timeline so that they're observing events progressively earlier, so at the moment they're watching events circa 1808. One explanation that the Foundation may have come up with is that the Tunguska event created a wormhole whose two ends (SCP-873 and SCP-873') are both moving away from the explosion in opposite directions. The things that would worry the Foundation: 1) if that explanation is accurate, then the paired set may be accumulating potential energy the further away from each other they get, and there may be an upper limit. 2) As the last addendum said, something else may be going on that may have caused the Tunguska event, and if so, it could happen again. 3) Aside from the wonky physics, information from the Foundation is leaking into the past, since progressively earlier incidences of SCP-837' receive data from progressively later incidences of SCP-837. So, when the Foundation had first contact with Dr. Ivan, it was at the point the good doctor had full knowledge of the Foundation's future communications with him, and possibly the Foundation's future communications with prior possessors of SCP-873'… and he didn't seem to take that knowledge very well.

item.content:encoded: I'm a little curious about one thing. Apparently, we're watching the events from the other (dimension/timeline/whatever) happen in reverse order; is that implying that time over there is happening in the opposite direction of ours, or that each "recording" is simply being "played backwards"? If it's the prior, then I would think that the later we get from Tunguska, the earlier BEFORE it we see… Unless there's hints and allegations from what they read that we will eventually start seeing their timeline before the mysterious explosion as being exactly like our own.
